title: Appliances installed in rooms that are large in comparison with the size of the appliance.
officialText:
Central-heating furnaces and
low-pressure boilers installed in rooms large in comparison with the size of the appliance shall be installed with clearances in
accordance with the terms of their listing and the manufacturer’s instructions.
